## About
Marcos and Angelo Collaco started Collaco Auto Repair to give people superior and honest service, with a focus on Volkswagen and Audi maintenance and repairs. They're factory-trained, and they want you to get high quality service you can trust without the cost of dealerships and chains.
We're based in Martinez with easy freeway access, and we work with drivers from Walnut Creek, Pleasant Hill and Concord too. Reviewers mention Manny, David and Brandie by name, and one even mentioned Wesley, the visiting dog.
We have a 4.9 rating from 90 Google reviews.

## Services
- General Repair: Everyday repair work, done professionally and honestly.
- Maintenance: Regular upkeep to keep your car running well over the long run.
- Electrical: Tracking down and repairing electrical problems.
- O.B.D. Diagnostics: Reading the codes behind a check engine light and finding the cause.
- Brakes: Brake service and repair.
- Clutch: Clutch repair and replacement.
- Engines and Transmissions: Engine and transmission work.
- Heating and Air Conditioning: Keeping your heat and A/C working the way they should.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in German and Japanese cars, especially Volkswagen and Audi.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Martinez and serve Walnut Creek, Pleasant Hill, Concord and the surrounding area.

Q: Do you do pre-purchase inspections?
A: Yes. Bring the car by before you buy and we'll look it over.
